$schema_note: entries: { rowId (quest row id or "*"), fact (fact name, or reward:<Kind> for reward rows), source (optional; "questionable" for a Questionable prerequisite link the catalog does not imply, checked by Tsukimichi.Verify questionable and QuestionableLinksTests), verdict, reason, evidence (URL, or a game reference such as a TEXT_ key or Sheet#row), fix (where a catalogWrong is corrected, or what a human must check for an unresolved row), until (release in which the fix lands; the entry expires once the plugin version reaches it, and CI fails while an expired entry is listed), rewardId (reward rows only: narrows the entry to that reward id), prereqId (questionable entries only: narrows the entry to that required quest) }. verdict "settled" (1.22.0) records a decision made on the evidence that no release will change: it needs evidence, a reason, one rowId and one fact (never "*") and settles (the verdicts the row was settled on, such as ["unresolved"]; an excused questionable link settles ["sourceWrong"]), carries no until, never expires, and excuses its row only while the row reads one of those verdicts, so a settled unresolved row that turns catalogWrong fails again; CI still fails it once no row needs it.

entries.reason: The Ties That Bind / Eternity Cake (Item 8791): decided quest-exclusive for 0.7.0. The wiki's only non-quest acquisition is the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding plans sold on the Online Store, but every plan includes the cake, the free Standard Plan too ({{onlinestore|0}}, 'available to all Plans' on https://ffxiv.consolegameswiki.com/wiki/Ceremony_of_Eternal_Bonding), and it is handed out as the fixed reward of this quest, which every plan runs. Nothing sells the cake apart from doing the quest, so it is not a store re-sell; the Lodestone item page lists the quest alone. The tool keeps reading the wiki's onlinestore template as one unconfirmed source, hence unresolved. Kept by decision; re-checked at each minor release (1.5.0: nothing changed). 1.11.0 review: nothing changed (the cake is still sold only with the ceremony); kept by decision until 1.15.0. 1.15.0: extended to 1.19.0, where feature plan v7 item C1 ("The game confirms it") checks it against live game state. 1.19.0 review: nothing changed (the cake is still sold only with the ceremony), and the game's own offers that C1 now records say nothing about a reward's other sources; kept by decision until 1.21.0. 1.21.0 review: nothing changed (the live wiki page on 2026-10-04 still sells the cake only with the ceremony plans, all of which run this quest); kept by decision until 1.22.0. 1.22.0 review: nothing changed (the live wiki page, revision 2026-07-22, still sells the cake only inside the three Ceremony of Eternal Bonding plans, all of which run this quest; the Lodestone item page lists the quest alone). Kept by decision; only an until extension or an owner-approved permanent exception can carry it past 1.22.0. Settled at 1.22.0 (owner ruling 2026-10-04): the cake is quest-only by decision, and no release will change the wiki's reading of the ceremony plans; re-check only if the cake is ever sold outside the ceremony.
entries.fix: none: kept quest-only by decision; re-check if the cake is ever sold outside the ceremony (then add item 8791 to curated/online_store.json)

entries.reason: Always a Bigger Fish: Questionable also makes it wait for A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience (68458), the spearfishing unlock. The quest text names only the main scenario quest Tide Goes in, Imperials Go Out (68026, now a curated extra) and the wiki agrees; where the game asks for spearfishing, its text says it is needed to proceed with a quest, not to take it. Single source, not added. 1.11.0 review: no sheet, quest script or game gate decides it, so the game data settles nothing more; extended to 1.15.0 for the in-game check (feature plan v6, C1). 1.15.0: extended to 1.19.0, where feature plan v7 item C1 ("The game confirms it") checks it against live game state. 1.19.0: the observer shipped (feature plan v7 C1); no character has stood near the giver with it running yet. 1.21.0 review: settled: Questionable's link is its own quirk. The quest's script checks spearfishing (A New Fishing Ex-spear-ience, QST_CHECK_STMBDY104) only in two mid-quest scenes, OnScene00020 and OnScene00023, to choose which of Wawalago's lines to speak; both ways the quest goes on. Its offer scene, OnScene00000, checks only Tide Goes in, Imperials Go Out (for a fisher of level 68 or above) and shows its own 'In order to undertake this quest' line naming that main scenario quest alone. Questionable still has the link at new-main 028ccd6d. The allowlist is the only place a Questionable link the catalog rightly leaves out can be recorded, so the entry stays with verdict sourceWrong. 1.22.0 review: Questionable still has the link at new-main db49ec12 (AddPreviousQuest(new(2898), new(2922)), Questionable/Data/QuestData.cs), so the verdict stands; only an until extension or an owner-approved permanent sourceWrong record can carry it past 1.22.0. Settled at 1.22.0 (owner ruling 2026-10-04): verdict sourceWrong on the evidence above; the entry stays only while Questionable keeps the link, and CI fails it once a refreshed docs/data/questionable-prerequisites.json drops it.
